notes: Independently read all 65 eligible production TypeScript files and both metadata files. The 107 plugin files partition into 67 reviewed and 40 excluded. Test helper exclusions were checked against callers; no production import overrides an exclusion.

All production relative imports, lazy imports, entrypoint descriptors and worker-operation module descriptors stay within extensions/reef. Local API and protocol barrels expose plugin-owned implementations/types, not reexports of imported SDK symbols. Separately installed dependencies are outside the audit.

src/runtime.ts creates one createPluginRuntimeStore<PluginRuntime> with getReefRuntime/getOptionalReefRuntime aliases and another store containing plugin-owned ActiveReef state. Only the first supplies public runtime provenance; activeReefStore, flow, friends, reviews, scheduler contexts and channel status runtime objects are not PluginRuntime member paths.

runtime.state.openKeyedStoreV2 has calls, a non-call read passed to openStores, and an explicit PluginRuntime indexed type. The callable openStore parameter preserves this public member's provenance. Returned keyed stores, operations, receipts, pairing controllers and locks do not become public API/runtime roots.

PluginRuntime["channel"]["routing"]["resolveAgentRoute"] and the corresponding runtime call make that runtime member mixed. ReturnType<typeof getReefRuntime> preserves the handle used by the setup helper; its modelConfig.resolveModelRuntimePolicy call is recorded without adding SDK-return-value paths.

The dynamic import of agent-scope-runtime in src/setup.ts resolves resolveSessionAgentIdStrict. The transport's asError import normalizes to the original toStringifiedError SDK export. Imported classes contribute call only where explicitly constructed; PluginStateOperationInvalidatedError is only imported and used in instanceof.

Known SDK helper calls are recorded as SDK exports without inferring their internal API/runtime consumption. In particular defineBundledChannelEntry does not create an api.registerChannel source finding, and passing the runtime to createChannelPairingController does not invent pairing runtime members.

Manifest identities include channels, cliCommands.name and commandAliases.name. doctorContract, categories, activation, descriptive metadata and configSchema are outside the agreed manifest identity fields. No named hook registrations occur.

Source-only reconciliation: PAIRING_APPROVED_MESSAGE passes unchanged through ReefMessageFlow.send into the body.text leaf. Reads in outbound-state-client.ts:145,179 and protocol/envelope.ts:278,290 contribute member-access to the original SDK export. This is a possible source dependency for the pairing path, not evidence that the path executed or that every send argument has SDK origin. Fresh containing objects do not inherit SDK identity; the known unchanged text leaf retains provenance. Normalized text, hashes, ciphertext and opaque return values do not retain it. Plugin-owned send/seal/hash calls and standard primitive methods such as trim/replace are not SDK calls.
